name: Confirmed web shell on upload04, then an analyst override
description: A PHP web shell is uploaded to docshare 3.1.4 and executed. The agent correctly concludes SUCCEEDED and blocks 203.0.113.9. Immediately after, an analyst records that the source is an authorised penetration test. The agent must unblock, add the exception, revise the assessment to OVERRIDDEN, and update the ticket. Final state: no blocked IPs, source on the allow-list.
